subject: How to get reactivity to work correctly when one reactive updates another?

messages.author: 6e2e3f40d727e099
messages.subject: How to get reactivity to work correctly when one reactive updates another?
parts:
Here is a simple sample shiny app. Note that the plot depends on two inputs: the variable selected, and the title. The user can change the title. BUT I also want the title to be automatically updated when a new variable is chosen.


It works fine, but my problem is that the plot updates twice when a new variable is chosen. First it updates because of the variable, and after a second the text input gets updated and the plot updates again.


How can I achieve my desired behaviour but without the plot running twice?


library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

ui <- fluidPage(
  selectInput("variable", "Select variable", names(iris)),
  textInput("title", "title", ""),
  plotOutput("plot")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observe({
    updateTextInput(session, "title", value = paste(input$variable, "histogram"))
  })

  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    Sys.sleep(1)
    ggplot(iris, aes_string(input$variable)) + geom_histogram() +
      ggtitle(input$title)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

messages.subject: Re: How to get reactivity to work correctly when one reactive updates another?
parts: You could use reactive values, which unlike input values, aren't invalidated when set to the same value. Example-

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

ui <- fluidPage(
  selectInput("variable", "Select variable", names(iris)),
  textInput("title", "title", ""),
  plotOutput("plot")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

plotTitle <- reactiveVal("")
  
  observe({
    title <- paste(input$variable, "histogram")
    plotTitle(title)
    updateTextInput(session, "title", value = title)
  })
  
  observe({
    plotTitle(input$title)

})
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    Sys.sleep(1)
    ggplot(iris, aes_string(input$variable)) + geom_histogram() +

ggtitle(plotTitle())
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)



You can take this a little further by changing both plot inputs to reactive values:

rv <- reactiveValues(title = NULL, variable = NULL)
  
  observeEvent(input$title, {
    req(input$title)
    rv$title <- input$title
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$variable, {
    rv$variable <- input$variable
    rv$title <- paste(input$variable, "histogram")
    
    updateTextInput(session, "title", value = rv$title)
  })
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    req(rv$title, rv$variable)
    
    Sys.sleep(1)
    ggplot(iris, aes_string(rv$variable)) + geom_histogram() +
      ggtitle(rv$title)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)


Now there's no double plot at the beginning. An input$variable change sets both the plot's variable and title inputs at the same time, triggering a single re-plot.
